reviewed_exceptions.decision: Accepted as a reviewed exception for this exact port and version. pkgconf runs only on the build host, through FFmpeg's vcpkg-pkgconfig-get-modules host dependency; no pkgconf executable, libpkgconf or pkg.m4 file is linked into or distributed with an Alumbra artefact.

reviewed_exceptions.selected_terms: LicenseRef-pkgconf-COPYING, a permissive ISC-style notice whose warranty disclaimer differs from canonical ISC
evidence: Pinned vcpkg port manifest ports/pkgconf/vcpkg.json (SHA-256 fe8a6ff047253163a70ddad7fccd8a3b32b83cbeb961f67246f889f54c1b44c6) declares an explicit null license field; installed SPDX 2.3 licenseConcluded is LicenseRef-vcpkg-null.

The portfile fetches pkgconf/pkgconf tag pkgconf-3.0.3, pinned by archive SHA-512 4e49bb7b10c6fdebfa1175b4c33138b8aeca2582e49adb5c7ba66d08e8614771ef060b0c2673bd098c1aed821c8ade1a6dd276c1f4ac6e29bd7efcb8f4c0402e; its COPYING is recorded verbatim in licence_texts.

The installed share/pkgconf/copyright concatenates COPYING with the notices of cli/getopt_long.c (LicenseRef-scancode-sudo AND BSD-4-Clause), cli/getopt_long.h and cli/spdxtool/main.c (BSD-2-Clause) and pkg.m4 (GPL-2.0-or-later with the Autoconf exception); copyright_sha256 pins that reviewed bundle.

pkgconf has only build dependency paths: the pinned FFmpeg port declares vcpkg-pkgconfig-get-modules as a host dependency, and that helper runs tools/pkgconf/pkgconf to query module flags while FFmpeg is built.
Alumbra's own build does not use pkg-config, and no pkgconf executable, libpkgconf or share/aclocal/pkg.m4 file is linked into or shipped with an Alumbra artefact.
